target.statement: SSD-30 achieves PSNR 28.71 / FID 36.77 / LPIPS 0.208 on CelebA 4x super-resolution with 30 NFEs

compute.basis: Requires downloading the CelebA VP-SDE checkpoint (~2 GB) and CelebA validation set, then running 30 NFE sampling over 1k images; on 8 CPU cores this is roughly 2-3 hours, while the paper reports ~2.5 s/image on an RTX 2080Ti.

blockers: Code is only promised 'upon publication' and may not be fully available or up-to-date
Requires implementing DA Inversion and back projection from the paper if code is incomplete
CPU-only inference will be significantly slower than the reported GPU timings
title: Accelerating Diffusion Models for Inverse Problems through Shortcut Sampling
